mapper.select: SELECT sm.match_id, sm.title, sm.sport_id, sm.start_at, sm.end_at, sm.max_participants, sm.status FROM social_match sm JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sm.match_id = #{matchId} FOR UPDATE OF sm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_application (match_id, applicant_user_id, club_id, application_type, status, receipt_no, created_at) VALUES (#{matchId}, #{applicantUserId}, #{clubId}, #{applicationType}, #{status}, #{receiptNo}, #{createdAt})
mapper.sql: application_id, match_id, applicant_user_id, club_id, application_type, status, receipt_no, created_at, confirmed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO match_participant (application_id, match_id, user_id, participation_status, entry_mmr, joined_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{matchId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{entryMmr}, #{joinedAt})
